|gr1= Time

|descr= Set simulation acceleration coefficient. May also be used to slow time in cutscenes.

|mp= Command is disabled in multiplayer.

|pr= This command is '''not''' clamped and incorrect values may be entered (negative values, high values, etc - game behaviour is then undefined).

|s1= [[setAccTime]] accFactor

|p1= accFactor: [[Number]] - time factor; 2 will make time go twice as fast, 0.5 half of it, etc

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>setAccTime 0.1;</sqf>

|seealso= [[accTime]] [[setTimeMultiplier]] [[timeMultiplier]] [[useAudioTimeForMoves]]

{{Note
|user= Hardrock
|timestamp= 20060804105800
|text= ''Notes from before the conversion:''

A good habit to get into is setting the [[accTime]] to 1 at the start of all cutscenes, in case the [[player]] is running at 4x speed when the scene starts.
